title: Proposed financial wire contracts; data definitions only
$comment: No deployed API. Cross-record invariants, precision, timestamps, authorization, hashes and publication guards are normative in policies.json; shape validation alone does not prove them. Numbers used for money/rates/units must be decimal strings.
